outcomes.execution: PASS only if all4fixed arms complete and integrity,containment,domain,nonwidening,coherent witness and zero-current controls pass. No10%benefit is not execution failure.
outcomes.research_pass: Q_INFORMATION_RESEARCH_SCREEN_PASS when both informative arms narrow by>=10%initial width.
outcomes.below_screen: DETECTABLE_Q_NARROWING_BELOW_RESEARCH_SCREEN when both informative arms exceed arithmetic detection tolerance but not both10%screen.
outcomes.mixed: MIXED_Q_INFORMATION_SIGNAL when only one informative arm exceeds arithmetic detection tolerance.
outcomes.inconclusive: INCONCLUSIVE_NO_DETECTABLE_Q_INFORMATION when neither informative arm exceeds arithmetic tolerance; not proof of structural unidentifiability or impossible learning.
outcomes.invalid: INVALID_OR_INCOMPLETE_RUN when integrity/containment/domain/control/requiredcompletion fails; stop later stages/arms, preserve all outputs.
